rules.statement: A co-owner who makes a plantation on the land held in common is entitled to take the entire produce of that plantation until the co-ownership is put an end to by a decree of the Court or mutual agreement. Similarly, a co-owner who erects a building on the land held in common is entitled to possess it until the land is partitioned.
rules.supporting_quote: A co-owner who makes a plantation on the undivided land is entitled to take the entire produce of that plantation until the co-ownership is put an end to by a decree of the Court or mutual agreement. Similarly a co-owner who erects a building on the land held in common is entitled to possess it until the land is partitioned.

meta.parties: Githohamy Et Al. v. Karanagoda Et Al
